property_summary: For every callee and every calldata byte string, a successful forward must make the callee observe exactly that calldata (msg.data), so a recording helper must store the forwarded data and forward must succeed; the buggy version sends no calldata, so the recorded data is empty and the rule fails for any non-empty input.
change_summary: Replace the low-level call with a transfer of zero value to the callee, which succeeds only for payability but does not execute calldata and can fail for non-payable contracts or out-of-gas cases depending on callee fallback behavior.
